newsitem.title: USA: Alottafun in pact to expand products.
newsitem.headline: Alottafun in pact to expand products.

text.p: Alottafun Inc, which develops and distributes toys, candy and specialty items, said it formed a joint venture agreement with Pro-Com International to develop a line of interactive toy and candy items.
Pro-Com, with offices in Toronto, Canada and Hong Kong, makes toys and novelties.
Alottafun said the agreement with Pro-Com is designed to allow it to move faster from a development stage into distribution.

In another development, the company said it enlarged the size and design of its major product, the Alottafun Surprise Box, which contains candy and toys. It is sold at convenience food outlets, gas stations and mini-markets.
